view: Frontal chest radiograph (PA, upright); L marker at the upper right corner of the image confirms conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs), adequate penetration (thoracic vertebrae visible through the cardiac silhouette), minimal rotation, apices and both costophrenic angles included. Scapulae partially overlap the upper lateral lung fields. No motion artifact.

devices.type: Median sternotomy wires (several twisted wire loops)
devices.location: Midline, projected over the sternum / upper-mid thoracic spine (approx. T2-T7 level)

devices.type: Prosthetic cardiac valve / annuloplasty ring (oval radiopaque ring, expected mitral position)
devices.location: Projected over the cardiac silhouette just left of the spine, at approx. T8-T9 level, below the line from right cardiophrenic angle to left hilum (mitral position)
Upper right corner of the image (patient's left side)

abnormalities.finding: Marked cardiomegaly, cardiothoracic ratio approx. 0.62, globular/rounded contour with left ventricular predominance; left heart border extends nearly to the left lateral chest wall
Suggestion of left atrial enlargement: convex/straightened left heart border below the pulmonary artery segment (prominent left atrial appendage segment)
Post-cardiac-surgery changes: median sternotomy wires and prosthetic mitral valve / annuloplasty ring
Unfolded, tortuous thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob (age-related ectasia)
Mildly increased bibasilar interstitial/bronchovascular markings without overt alveolar edema (possible mild congestion vs chronic change; uncertain)
Degenerative changes of the glenohumeral joints, more evident on the left shoulder

description_zh: 胸部正面X光片（PA站立位），吸氣深度與穿透度尚可，輕微旋轉，右上角可見L側標記。可見正中胸骨切開術鋼絲，以及投影於心影內、脊椎左側二尖瓣位置之橢圓形人工瓣膜環（人工二尖瓣或瓣環成形環），為心臟手術後變化。心影明顯擴大（心胸比約0.62），左心緣圓鈍外凸並延伸至近左側胸壁，左心緣肺動脈段下方隆起提示左心房擴大，胸主動脈迂曲且主動脈結突出。雙肺野大致清晰，雙下肺野輕度間質紋理增加但無明顯肺水腫，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利；兩側肩關節有退化性變化，未見胸管或引流管。
